sections.contraindications: Sulfamethoxazole-trimethoprim is contraindicated in patients with a known hypersensitivity to sulfonamides or trimethoprim. A history of sulfonamide allergy may predispose patients to severe hypersensitivity reactions, including Stevens-Johnson syndrome.
sections.warnings: Fatal hypersensitivity reactions, including Stevens-Johnson syndrome and toxic epidermal necrolysis, have occurred with sulfonamides. Discontinue at the first appearance of skin rash. Patients with a sulfonamide allergy are at increased risk.
sections.drug_interactions: Sulfamethoxazole-trimethoprim may potentiate the effect of warfarin and oral hypoglycemic agents. Monitor accordingly.
